transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
Yeah… I guess the main thing is at work. I keep getting up from my desk during the day, even when I know I’m supposed to stay there and finish reviewing claims. It’s been getting hard to manage.
Do you often feel restless or have trouble staying seated, even when you know you should stay at your desk?
Yeah… that’s pretty much it. I keep getting up from my workstation during the day, even when I know I’m supposed to stay there and finish the claim reviews. It’s kind of the main reason I came in.
Outside of work, do you find yourself getting up frequently when you’re supposed to stay seated, like during meetings or while relaxing at home?

Mostly at work, honestly. That’s the thing I’ve noticed most — I keep getting up from my workstation when I’m supposed to stay there and finish the claim reviews. Outside of that… I’m not really sure.
When you're at work, do you feel a strong urge to get up and move around, even if you know you should stay seated to finish your work?
Yeah… at work it’s like I just don’t stay put. I know I’m supposed to sit there and finish the claim reviews, but I keep getting up from my workstation anyway. That’s mostly why I came in.
Do you ever feel the need to get up and move around in places other than work, like when you’re at home or in a meeting?

Not really that I’ve noticed. It’s mainly at work… I keep getting up from my workstation when I’m supposed to stay there and get through the claim reviews. That’s the part that’s been causing problems.
When you're at work, do you have trouble focusing on the claim reviews or find your mind wandering, even when you're trying to stay on task?

Yeah… I do. If people nearby start talking about another claim, or I suddenly remember some random errand, I kind of lose the thread of what I’m reading. Then I have to go back and reread the same section a few times.
Have you ever had trouble staying seated in situations where you’re expected to stay still, like during a long meeting, a movie, or a meal, even outside of work?

Mostly it’s at work. I keep getting up from my workstation during the day, even when I know I’m supposed to stay there and finish the claim reviews. Outside of that… I can’t really say it’s been a big thing.
Outside of work, do you ever have trouble staying focused on tasks or find yourself getting distracted easily, like during chores at home or while reading something?

Yeah… a bit. It’s more like if someone nearby starts talking about another claim, or I remember some random errand, I lose track of what I was reading. Then I end up rereading the same part a few times.
Looking back, did you have similar issues with staying seated or focusing on tasks when you were a child, like in school?

Yeah… I think so. Not so much that I remember every detail, but in elementary school teachers would say I was bright, but I’d lose worksheets or miss instructions. I needed reminders to actually finish classwork sometimes.
Can you think of any situations outside of work, like at home or with friends, where you’ve had trouble staying seated or focusing on what you’re supposed to be doing?

Yeah… sometimes. If I’m trying to read something and people nearby start talking, or I suddenly remember some errand I forgot, I kind of lose the thread. Then I have to go back and reread the same part a few times.
As a child, did you often feel restless or have trouble staying still in situations where it was expected, like during class or at the dinner table?

I don’t remember a ton from when I was a kid, honestly. These days, in longer meetings or trainings, I do notice I’m usually bouncing my leg or clicking a pen, shifting around in the chair… even when I’m trying to look like I’m paying attention.
Can you think of any situations outside of work, like at home or in social settings, where you’ve had noticeable trouble staying seated or focusing on what you’re supposed to be doing?

Yeah… mostly with reading or paperwork-type stuff at home too. If people nearby start talking, or I suddenly remember some random errand, my attention kind of slips off what I’m reading. Then I’ll realize I didn’t take it in and have to reread the same section a few times.
Do you often feel restless or find yourself moving around unnecessarily in situations other than work, like when you’re at home or in public places?

Yeah… I mean, the main place I notice it is at work. I keep getting up from my workstation when I’m supposed to be staying there and getting through claim reviews. I know I should just sit and finish, but I end up moving around anyway.
Have these difficulties with staying seated and focusing affected other parts of your life, like your relationships, performance at work, or ability to complete tasks at home?

Yeah… mostly at work. My claim files have been falling behind, and my supervisor put me on performance coaching. They’ve also started questioning my accuracy, so… I’m worried it could mess up the senior adjuster track I was trying to get on.
Can you think of specific examples when you’ve had trouble staying seated or focusing on tasks outside of work, such as at home, in public places, or during social interactions?

Yeah… I guess when I’m trying to read something, even at home, if people nearby start talking or I suddenly remember some errand, I just kind of lose the thread. I’ll keep looking at the page, but then I realize I didn’t actually take it in and have to reread the same part a few times.

Can you think of times when you’ve had trouble staying seated or focusing on tasks that weren’t related to work or reading at home — like when you’re with friends, during a meal, or in a public place?
I’m not sure. Nothing really specific comes to mind outside of the stuff I mentioned. Maybe I zone out sometimes, but I haven’t really noticed it as a big thing with friends or meals.
